findings.evidence: The expressions occur at lines 119–125 and 149–151; `rg` finds no declaration named `antipode_comul_op`, while the same file’s public theorem is `antipode_comul_antidistrib` at line 178 and Mathlib uses `CategoryTheory.HopfObj.antipode_comul`.
findings.fix: Rename both with the established stem, e.g. `antipode_comul_antidistrib_rhs_eq_convMul` and `antipode_comul_antidistrib_rhs_mul_comul`.
findings.issue: `antipode_comul_op_eq_convMul` and `antipode_comul_op_mul_comul` (line 148) use `op` as an invented name for `(S ⊗ S) ∘ swap ∘ Δ`; in Mathlib terminology `op` conventionally denotes passage to an opposite type, while the adjacent declaration calls this `antipode_comul_antidistrib`.

summary: Two extracted lemma names use the undefined and misleading abbreviation `antipode_comul_op` for the anti-comultiplicativity right-hand side.
